scenario: Simulated Camp Fire morning in Paradise, CA. Part 2 of 2: the 'skip ahead 30 minutes' batch. Send as text at high speed after camp_live. It updates some part 1 incidents (high school, hospital, Bille Road, Pentz Road vehicle, the unclear school call) and opens many new ones. Call 13 contradicts PD on purpose.
writer_model: claude-opus-5-5 (review session, written in chat; a different model family from the extractor)

calls.text: Engine 33, emergency traffic. Burnover on Edgewood Lane at Pentz Road. Six civilians trapped in their vehicles, fire across the road in both directions. We are sheltering them behind the engine. Need air support and a second engine now.
Battalion 5, I confirm Ponderosa Elementary on Pentz Road. The school is empty, staff took all students out earlier. The building is starting to burn from the west side, medium size.
Medic 44, Adventist Health Feather River. Fire has reached the parking lot. Twelve patients are still inside, two on ventilators. We need help at the hospital now.
Paradise PD 7, power lines down across all lanes of Skyway at Elliott Road. Skyway is blocked at Elliott, no traffic can pass.
Medic 41, the patient from Bille Road is loaded. Transporting to Chico, stable.
Engine 81, buses are on scene at Paradise High School. Eighty occupants are out and loaded. Forty three are still in the gym. Fire is in the east wing, the gym is still clear.
Butte SO 4, Magalia, Coutolenc Road. Spot fires near about ten homes. Several residents refuse to leave. Requesting more deputies for door to door evacuation.
Paradise PD 3, Clark Road at Wagstaff Road. Traffic is moving but the smoke is heavy, visibility is near zero. Requesting lights and cones.
Butte SO 12, the two occupants from the vehicle on Pentz Road at Wagstaff are out. Both walking, minor smoke exposure, sending them south with a patrol car.
Paradise PD 9, about two hundred evacuees are sheltering in the Holiday Market parking lot on Skyway. Fire is getting near. They need direction, do we hold them here or move them?
Engine 26, small spot fire in Paradise Community Park. We have it, no help needed.
Engine 35, Oliver Road. An elderly couple is trapped in their house, the garage is on fire. Two people. We are going in.
Paradise PD 11, I heard Skyway is open again at Neal Road? Can someone confirm, I am sending cars that way.
Water Tender 2, Buschmann Road. Hydrant pressure is low, engines on Buschmann are running out of water. Requesting another water tender.
Engine 33, Pine Ridge Elementary School in Magalia. Fire on the north side of the campus, medium size. No students on site.
Dozer 1, Pentz Road is blocked by burning trees south of Edgewood Lane. I can clear it in about fifteen minutes. Requesting an engine to cover me.
Medic 47, one firefighter at Edgewood Lane with burns to both hands, minor. We are treating on scene.
Paradise PD 7, correction for all units, Skyway is still blocked at Elliott Road and at Neal Road. Do not send traffic to Skyway. Use Clark Road.
Battalion 3, Paradise High School, all one hundred twenty three occupants are out. The gym is now involved. We are going defensive.
Engine 82, Paradise Fire Station 81 on Skyway is threatened. Crews are staying to defend the station.
Medic 44, all patients are out of Adventist Health Feather River. Both ventilator patients moved. The building is burning.
Engine 33, Edgewood Lane, the six civilians are still with us. Fire front passed, we can move them out once Dozer 1 clears Pentz Road.
